meta.title: Implement SDL caching in CI
meta.body_summary: Add CI caching for SDL build outputs using actions/cache in main.yml to speed up GitHub Actions runs.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added CI caching via actions/cache; author closed PR 27 seconds later without merge, likely unintended or test.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 26 changed lines, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It fits a trivial CI optimization, but the PR was closed immediately without merge, consistent with an unintended or test submission rather than a serious perf improvement.

core_change_summary.description: Added a new `Cache SDL build` step in the `build-sdl` job of `.github/workflows/main.yml` that caches `~/.cache/vcpkg`, `~/vcpkg`, and `~/vcpkg-clapack` using `actions/cache@v3`, keyed on OS and a hash of `frontends/sdl/Cargo.toml`.
change_trajectory: Single commit adding the vcpkg cache step; no subsequent revisions.

CodeRabbit bot reported a rate limit exceeded, provided a walkthrough of the change.
Author closed the PR 27 seconds after creation.
